name: Tu hài
summary: Tu hài is sold by the kilogram or by a count per kilogram. Kitchens also write it tự hài, and keep tu hài tự nhiên apart from tu hài thường.
howToEat: Order it by weight. Island seafood is at its best in winter, before the spring spawn.
where: Đường 1/4, đường Núi Ngọc, and the quay kitchens at Bến Bèo.
seoDescription: Tu hài is sold by the kilogram or by a count per kilogram on the harbor streets and at Bến Bèo.
